name: Feature Request

labels: feature, triage

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe alternatives you've considered and why they're not ideal.

## User Story

As a [persona], I want to [action], so that [benefit].

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Mockups / References

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features in other products.

## Priority

- [ ] Critical (blocks release)
- [ ] High (should be in next release)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have soon)
- [ ] Low (backlog)

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
